LESSON: READING 5.2.1 READING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information, part of Strand 5 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read a passage on the theme of cultural diversity,

2. collaborate with peers to answer direct questions,

3. outline the main ideas from the passage,

4. respond to inferential questions on the theme of the passage,

5. collaborate with peers to identify vocabulary related to the theme and read aloud,

6. work jointly to infer the meaning of vocabulary in context,

7. make sentences using the vocabulary identified and review each other’s sentences.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. conduct a reader’s theatre to read a passage on the theme of cultural diversity,
2. collaborate with peers to answer direct questions,
3. outline the main ideas from the passage,
4. respond to inferential questions on the theme of the passage,
5. collaborate with peers to identify vocabulary related to the theme and read aloud,
6. work jointly to infer the meaning of vocabulary in context,
7. make sentences using the vocabulary identified and review each other’s sentences.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: This is enhanced when the learner shows concerted attention when working jointly to infer the meaning

of vocabulary in context.

• Citizenship: This is enhanced as the learner gains knowledge of cultural diversity from reading texts on the theme.

Values:
Unity: This is enhanced as the learner teams with others to review the sentences written using the vocabulary they have

learnt.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion is promoted as the learner embraces respect for other people on account of knowledge acquired on cultural

diversity.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate information on cultural diversity acquired from varied texts to Social Studies.
